design-tokens.component.alert.name: Alert
design-tokens.component.alert.text: A message box for success, information, warnings and errors, such as “Your changes were saved” or a form error at the top of a page.
design-tokens.component.annotation.name: Annotation
design-tokens.component.annotation.text: A small pointing label next to a value, such as the passing grade on a progress bar.
design-tokens.component.avatar.name: Profile picture
design-tokens.component.avatar.text: The user’s picture in the header, on the profile page and in discussions.
design-tokens.component.badge.name: Badge
design-tokens.component.badge.text: A small colored label: “New”, “Verified”, a course status or a count.
design-tokens.component.breadcrumb.name: Breadcrumb
design-tokens.component.breadcrumb.text: The “Home / Course / Unit” trail that shows where you are in a course or in the course editor.
design-tokens.component.bubble.name: Counter bubble
design-tokens.component.bubble.text: A round counter, such as the number of unread notifications or of errors.
design-tokens.component.button.name: Button
design-tokens.component.button.note: Hover over and click the buttons to see their hover and pressed colors.
design-tokens.component.button.text: The main action control: Enroll, Save, Submit, Next. Every style (solid, outline, on dark backgrounds, tertiary, link) has its own background, text and border colors, and colors for hover, pressed, focus and disabled.
design-tokens.component.card.name: Card
design-tokens.component.card.text: A box that groups content: course cards on the dashboard and in the catalog, and settings panels in the course editor.
design-tokens.component.carousel.name: Carousel
design-tokens.component.carousel.text: Slides with previous and next controls, such as featured courses.
design-tokens.component.chip.name: Chip
design-tokens.component.chip.text: A pill for filters, tags and selected options, such as catalog filters or discussion topics.
design-tokens.component.close-button.tex: The × button that closes alerts, dialogs and banners.
design-tokens.component.code.name: Code
design-tokens.component.code.text: Code and keyboard keys shown in course content and help text.
design-tokens.component.collapsible.name: Collapsible section
design-tokens.component.collapsible.text: A section that opens and closes, such as course outline sections and questions and answers.
design-tokens.component.color-picker.tex: A color swatch that opens a picker, used in course settings.
design-tokens.component.dropdown.name: Dropdown
design-tokens.component.dropdown.text: A button that opens a list of actions, such as the user menu in the header or course actions on the dashboard.
design-tokens.component.dropzone.name: Upload area
design-tokens.component.dropzone.text: The area where files are dropped to upload them, such as course files and the profile photo.
design-tokens.component.form.name: Form fields
design-tokens.component.form.text: Text fields, lists, text areas, checkboxes, radio buttons and switches, with their labels, help text, and selected, valid and invalid states: sign-in and registration, account settings and course editor forms.
design-tokens.component.icon-button.name: Icon button
design-tokens.component.icon-button.text: A button that shows only an icon: “more” menus, edit and delete actions, close buttons.
design-tokens.component.icon.name: Icon
design-tokens.component.icon.text: The icon sizes used in buttons, alerts, menus and inputs.
design-tokens.component.image.name: Image
design-tokens.component.image.text: Images with a frame or rounded corners, and images with a caption.
design-tokens.component.layout.name: Page layout
design-tokens.component.layout.text: How content is placed on the page: content width, columns, space between items, the row of buttons at the bottom of forms and scroll areas.
design-tokens.component.link.name: Link
design-tokens.component.link.text: Text links and their hover color and underline: links in courses, “learn more” links and footer links.
design-tokens.component.menu.name: Menu
design-tokens.component.menu.text: A list of choices in a panel, used by select menus and by the “add” menus of the course editor.
design-tokens.component.modal.name: Dialog
design-tokens.component.modal.text: A window over the page that asks for a decision or shows a form: confirm a deletion, edit settings, special offers.
design-tokens.component.navbar.name: Navigation bar
design-tokens.component.navbar.text: A horizontal bar with the site name and navigation links.
design-tokens.component.other.name: Other components
design-tokens.component.other.text: Component design tokens that do not belong to a component above.
design-tokens.component.page-banner.name: Page banner
design-tokens.component.page-banner.text: A full-width strip at the top of the page for notices to everyone, such as planned maintenance.
design-tokens.component.pagination.name: Pagination
design-tokens.component.pagination.text: Page numbers and previous / next buttons under long lists and tables.
design-tokens.component.popover.name: Popover
design-tokens.component.popover.text: A small panel with a title and text that opens next to an element when it is clicked.
design-tokens.component.progress.name: Progress bar
design-tokens.component.progress.text: Course progress and upload progress, with an optional passing grade marker.
design-tokens.component.search.name: Search field
design-tokens.component.search.text: The search box with its search and clear buttons, such as catalog search and discussion search.
design-tokens.component.selectable.name: Selectable box
design-tokens.component.selectable.text: A large box that is clicked to choose it, like a radio button or checkbox, such as choosing a plan or a content type.
design-tokens.component.sheet.name: Side panel
design-tokens.component.sheet.text: A panel that slides in from the side of the screen, such as filters or notifications.
design-tokens.component.skeleton.name: Loading placeholder
design-tokens.component.skeleton.text: Gray placeholder lines shown while content is loading.
design-tokens.component.spinner.name: Loading spinner
design-tokens.component.spinner.text: The turning circle shown while a page or an action is loading.
design-tokens.component.stepper.name: Steps
design-tokens.component.stepper.text: The numbered steps of a task done in several steps, with the current step and steps that have an error.
design-tokens.component.table.name: Data table
design-tokens.component.table.text: Tables that can be sorted, filtered, selected and paged, such as the gradebook, course files and admin lists.
design-tokens.component.tabs.name: Tabs and navigation
design-tokens.component.tabs.text: Tabs that switch between views, such as course tabs and account settings sections, and pill-shaped navigation.
design-tokens.component.text.name: Text and headings
design-tokens.component.text.text: Heading and body text colors, the heading font, muted text and list spacing: the text of every page, such as the course outline, the dashboard and account settings.
design-tokens.component.toast.name: Toast
design-tokens.component.toast.text: A short message in the corner of the screen after an action, such as “Saved”, with an optional Undo.
design-tokens.component.tooltip.name: Tooltip
design-tokens.component.tooltip.text: A short hint that appears when you point at or focus an element, such as an icon button.
design-tokens.component.tour.name: Guided tour
design-tokens.component.tour.text: Step-by-step hints that point at parts of the page to introduce new features.
design-tokens.demo.alert.heading: {style} message
design-tokens.demo.banner.text: {style} banner: the site will be updated on Sunday.
design-tokens.demo.breadcrumb.label: Breadcrumb
design-tokens.demo.button.groups: Button groups, toggles and buttons that show progress
design-tokens.demo.button.more: Link style, sizes, icons and disabled
design-tokens.demo.card.horizontal-text: The image is beside the text.
design-tokens.demo.card.text: Short course description on the card.
design-tokens.demo.card.title: Course title
design-tokens.demo.dropdown.open: Open list, to check its colors
design-tokens.demo.form.no-label: Without a visible label, for example in table rows
design-tokens.demo.image.caption: Image caption
design-tokens.demo.layout.columns: Columns that change with the screen width
design-tokens.demo.layout.long-text: A long paragraph that is cut after two lines so that cards and lists keep the same height, with an ellipsis at the end of the visible text.
design-tokens.demo.layout.space: Space between items, and a row of buttons
design-tokens.demo.link.external: Link that opens a new tab
design-tokens.demo.pagination.label: Pagination ({style})
design-tokens.demo.popover.title: Popover title
design-tokens.demo.sheet.title: Side panel
design-tokens.demo.text.heading: Page heading
design-tokens.demo.text.muted: Muted text for hints and less important information.
design-tokens.demo.text.paragraph: Body text in a paragraph, the way course content and settings pages show it.
design-tokens.demo.tooltip.hover: Tooltip shown when you point here
design-tokens.demo.tour.courses-text: Every course you are enrolled in is listed here.
design-tokens.demo.tour.progress-text: See how far you are in each course.
design-tokens.demo.typography.heading: Heading {level}
design-tokens.describe.component: Changes the {property} of {target}{state, select, hover { when the pointer is over it} active { while it is pressed} focus { when it has keyboard focus} disabled { when it is disabled} checked { when it is checked} selected { when it is selected} visited { after the link was visited} invalid { when its value is not valid} valid { when its value is valid} indeterminate { when only some items are selected} other {}}.
design-tokens.describe.dependents: Changing it also changes {count, plural, one {# value that follows it} other {# values that follow it}}: {sections}.
design-tokens.dialogs.error.title: Something went wrong
design-tokens.editor.error.characters: This value contains characters that are not allowed.
design-tokens.editor.error.color: Enter a valid color, for example #EB5939.
design-tokens.editor.error.empty: Enter a value, or use Reset.
design-tokens.editor.error.unbalanced: Close every quote and bracket that this value opens.
design-tokens.editor.follows.help: A value that follows another one changes when that one changes. Hover and pressed shades that are calculated from a color do not follow it: change them here directly.
design-tokens.editor.intro: {count, plural, one {# design token} other {# design tokens}} for {mode}. Saved values show on the page right away.
design-tokens.editor.reset.scope: Reset {name} ({count, plural, one {# saved} other {# saved}})
design-tokens.editor.title: Edit {name}
design-tokens.fonts.upload.failed: The font could not be added. Use a WOFF2, WOFF, TTF or OTF file.
design-tokens.fonts.upload.help: WOFF2, WOFF, TTF or OTF. The name, weight and style come from the file name, for example “OpenSans-BoldItalic.ttf”. Upload one file per weight.
design-tokens.global.colors.name: Brand and status colors
design-tokens.global.colors.text: The two brand colors (primary and secondary) and the status colors (success, information, warning, danger). Buttons, links, focus rings, badges, alerts and many other components follow these, so change them first.
design-tokens.global.elevation.name: Shadows
design-tokens.global.elevation.text: Shadows that lift cards, menus, popovers and dialogs above the page.
design-tokens.global.motion.name: Motion
design-tokens.global.motion.text: How fast alerts, dialogs and tooltips fade in and out.
design-tokens.global.other.name: Other global design tokens
design-tokens.global.other.text: Global design tokens that do not belong to a group above.
design-tokens.global.palette.name: Gray scales and tinted backgrounds
design-tokens.global.palette.text: The gray and light scales, from lightest to darkest, and the tinted backgrounds behind alerts and status messages. In dark mode the scales are reversed so that the same components read light on dark.
design-tokens.global.size.name: Corners and borders
design-tokens.global.size.text: How round the corners of buttons, inputs and cards are, and how thick borders are.
design-tokens.global.spacing.name: Spacing
design-tokens.global.spacing.text: The spacing scale used for padding and margins, and the space at the sides of the page.
design-tokens.global.surfaces.name: Page background and borders
design-tokens.global.surfaces.text: The page background, the default border color and the color around a selected input, on every page.
design-tokens.global.typography.name: Typography
design-tokens.global.typography.text: The font, the text size scale, heading and body sizes, weights and line heights. All text on every page uses these.
design-tokens.history.action.theme-code: Went back to the theme of the token files
design-tokens.history.empty: No changes yet. Every change you save is listed here and can be reverted.
design-tokens.history.intro: Changes saved for {mode}, newest first. Reverting a change adds a new entry at the top and keeps every entry below it.
design-tokens.history.reverted: The values are already as before this change.
design-tokens.history.reverted.toast: {count, plural, one {# value reverted} other {# values reverted}}. The revert was added to the history.
design-tokens.history.show-all: Show all {count, plural, one {# value} other {# values}}
design-tokens.history.title: History of all changes
design-tokens.import.changes: {count, plural, =0 {No values will change} one {# value will change} other {# values will change}}
design-tokens.import.done: {count, plural, one {# value imported} other {# values imported}}. The import was added to the history.
design-tokens.import.error.read: This file could not be read. Choose a JSON file made with “Download saved values”.
design-tokens.import.intro: Values from {file} are checked before anything is saved. They are saved for {mode} and added to the history, so you can revert the import.
design-tokens.import.invalid: {count, plural, one {# value is not valid and is skipped} other {# values are not valid and are skipped}}
design-tokens.import.keep.label: {count, plural, one {# value saved now is not in the file} other {# values saved now are not in the file}}
design-tokens.import.mode-warning: This file was downloaded from {fileMode}. Its values will be used for {mode}.
design-tokens.import.replace: Put them back to the original values, so only the file is used
design-tokens.import.same: {count, plural, one {# value is already the same} other {# values are already the same}}
design-tokens.import.title: Import values
design-tokens.import.unknown: {count, plural, one {# name is not a design token of this page and is skipped} other {# names are not design tokens of this page and are skipped}}
design-tokens.load-failed: The saved values could not be loaded. Reload the page to try again.
design-tokens.page.card.count: {count, plural, one {# design token} other {# design tokens}}
design-tokens.page.card.error: This example could not be shown.
design-tokens.page.card.none: No design tokens of its own: it follows the global design tokens.
design-tokens.page.card.saved: {count, plural, one {# saved value} other {# saved values}}
design-tokens.page.mode.dark.name: dark mode
design-tokens.page.mode.label: Color mode
design-tokens.page.mode.light.name: light mode
design-tokens.page.saved.reset.confirm: Remove {count, plural, one {the # saved value} other {all # saved values}} for {mode}?
design-tokens.page.saved.reset.confirm.t: The design tokens of this mode go back to the values of the token files. The change stays in History, so you can undo it.
design-tokens.page.sidebar.label: Sections
design-tokens.page.step1.text: Change these first. Components follow them: the primary color, fonts, spacing and corner radius change every component below that uses them.
design-tokens.page.step1.title: Global design tokens
design-tokens.page.step2.text: Fine-tune single components. A value set here changes only that component, for example the text color of a solid button.
design-tokens.page.step2.title: Component design tokens
design-tokens.page.title: Design tokens
design-tokens.page.toast.saved: {name}: {count, plural, one {# change saved} other {# changes saved}}.
design-tokens.preview.discarded: Preview discarded. The apps show the saved values again.
design-tokens.preview.failed: The preview could not be updated. Try again in a moment.
design-tokens.preview.save: Save {count, plural, one {# change} other {# changes}}
design-tokens.preview.saved: {count, plural, one {# change} other {# changes}} saved.
design-tokens.preview.started: The apps now show your changes.
design-tokens.preview.text: This page and every Open edX app now show these values for {mode}. Open an app and move around it; reload app pages that are already open. Save the changes if you like them, or discard them.
design-tokens.preview.title: Preview of {count, plural, one {# unsaved change} other {# unsaved changes}}
design-tokens.property.offset: distance from the element it belongs to
design-tokens.property.padding-y: inner space at the top and bottom
design-tokens.save-failed: The change could not be saved. Try again in a moment.
design-tokens.term.caption: caption
design-tokens.term.heading: heading
design-tokens.term.label: label
design-tokens.term.title: title
design-tokens.themes.applied: The theme “{name}” is in use for light and dark.
design-tokens.themes.code.applied: The values of the token files are back for light and dark.
design-tokens.themes.code.name: Code theme
design-tokens.themes.code.text: The values written in the token files (paragon/tokens/src), without saved changes.
design-tokens.themes.color.background.he: The background of every page, behind cards and content.
design-tokens.themes.color.border.help: Lines around cards, tables and other boxes, and dividers. Buttons and form fields keep their own borders.
design-tokens.themes.color.brand.help: Your organization’s signature color, for brand buttons, badges and other brand accents. When it is the same as the primary color, it keeps following the primary color.
design-tokens.themes.color.headings.help: Page and section titles (h1 to h6), often a little stronger than the body text.
design-tokens.themes.color.link.help: Links in text and link buttons. Often different in dark mode: buttons need a primary dark enough for white labels, links need a color light enough to read on the dark background. When it is the same as the primary color, it keeps following the primary color.
design-tokens.themes.color.primary.help: The main action color: solid buttons, focus outlines, selected tabs, checkboxes and progress bars; its lighter and darker shades and the hover colors follow it. Button labels stay white, so it has to be dark enough for white text.
design-tokens.themes.color.secondary.hel: Less prominent actions and accents: secondary buttons, badges and chips.
design-tokens.themes.color.surface.help: Cards, dialogs, dropdown menus, lists and data tables sit on this color. The same as the page background gives a flat look; a slightly different color makes cards stand out.
design-tokens.themes.color.text.help: Paragraphs, labels, form fields and menus: all text except headings and links.
design-tokens.themes.confirm.code.text: All values saved for light and dark are removed. Every change stays in History, so you can undo it.
design-tokens.themes.confirm.code.title: Go back to the values of the token files?
design-tokens.themes.confirm.delete.text: The theme cannot be restored. The values it saved stay until you choose another theme.
design-tokens.themes.confirm.use.text: It replaces all values saved for light and dark. Every change stays in History, so you can undo it.
design-tokens.themes.confirm.use.title: Use the theme “{name}”?
design-tokens.themes.create.text: Pick a few colors and fonts; every design token follows them.
design-tokens.themes.created-only: The theme “{name}” was created. Choose Use theme on its card when you want to apply it.
design-tokens.themes.dialog.colors.help: Each color has a value for light screens and one for dark screens, so they can differ, for example a lighter link color on a dark background.
design-tokens.themes.dialog.contrast.low: Hard to read: aim for 4.5:1 or more.
design-tokens.themes.dialog.create.title: Create a theme
design-tokens.themes.dialog.edit.title: Edit the theme “{name}”
design-tokens.themes.dialog.hex.dark: {name} for dark screens as a hex value
design-tokens.themes.dialog.hex.light: {name} for light screens as a hex value
design-tokens.themes.dialog.in-use: This theme is in use, so saving applies the new values to light and dark.
design-tokens.themes.dialog.intro: Only the colors that no other color is worked out from, for light and for dark screens, and the fonts: shades, hover colors and most components follow them. Status colors (success, warning, danger, info) and everything else stay as they are; change them in the design tokens afterwards.
design-tokens.themes.dialog.name: Theme name
design-tokens.themes.dialog.palettes.hel: Fills in the colors below. You can change each one afterwards.
design-tokens.themes.dialog.pick-color.d: Pick the {name} color for dark screens
design-tokens.themes.dialog.pick-color.l: Pick the {name} color for light screens
design-tokens.themes.font.body.help: Paragraphs, buttons, forms and menus: all text except headings.
design-tokens.themes.font.headings.help: Page and section titles (h1 to h6).
design-tokens.themes.intro: A theme sets the most important colors and fonts for light and dark screens at once. Choose one, then change any design token below.
design-tokens.themes.load-failed: The themes could not be loaded. Check that "npm run preview" is running, then reload the page.
design-tokens.themes.preview.discarded: The theme preview has ended. Nothing was saved.
design-tokens.themes.preview.help: Preview shows the theme on this page and in every app, without saving it.
design-tokens.themes.preview.started: The theme “{name}” is shown as a preview here and in every app. Nothing is saved yet.
design-tokens.themes.preview.text: This page and every app show it for light and dark screens, but nothing is saved. Everyone who opens the apps sees it until you apply or discard it.
design-tokens.themes.preview.title: Previewing the theme “{name}”
design-tokens.themes.sample.heading: Course title
design-tokens.themes.sample.text: Body text as learners read it on this screen.
design-tokens.themes.save-failed: The themes could not be saved. Check that "npm run preview" is running, then try again.
design-tokens.themes.title: Themes
tb.brand.advanced.text: Applied last on the LMS and Studio pages (not the apps), on top of the theme. Use the design tokens for everything else.
tb.brand.advanced.title: Extra CSS for LMS and Studio pages
tb.brand.badType: Choose a PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP or ICO image.
tb.brand.drop: Drop an image here or use Upload
tb.brand.favicon.text: The icon in the browser tab and bookmarks. A square PNG or ICO, at least 64 × 64 pixels.
tb.brand.favicon.title: Favicon
tb.brand.footerLogo.help: Used in dark mode and in the footer. A light or white version of the logo.
tb.brand.logos.text: Shown in the header of the LMS, Studio and every learner and author app. PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP up to 2 MB; a wide image with a transparent background works best.
tb.brand.logos.title: Logos
tb.brand.tooLarge: The image must be 2 MB or smaller.
tb.footer.appearance.text: Background of the footer on every page. The text color is chosen automatically so it stays readable.
tb.footer.appearance.title: Appearance
tb.footer.background.help: For example #171621. Leave empty to keep the color of the theme.
tb.footer.contact.text: Address and email shown in the site footer. Leave a field empty to hide it.
tb.footer.contact.title: Contact
tb.footer.copyright.help: For example: © 2026 Your Organization. All rights reserved.
tb.footer.copyright.title: Copyright
tb.footer.social.text: Full addresses, starting with https://. Empty links are not shown.
tb.footer.social.title: Social links
tb.footer.tagline.help: A short line under the footer logo. Leave empty to show none.
tb.portal.footer.intro: Contact details, social links and copyright shown in the site footer.
tb.portal.intro: Colors, fonts and every design token of the learner and author apps. A save is live on the next page load; previews are only shown to administrators.
tb.portal.logos.intro: The logos and browser icon of the LMS, Studio and every learner and author app.
tb.portal.title: Theme & branding
tb.settings.loadFailed: The settings could not be loaded. Reload the page to try again.
tb.settings.saved: Saved. The site shows the change on the next page load.
